services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Join us for a relaxing Sunset Dolphin Cruise and enjoy one of the most scenic experiences in Tarpon Springs. Our captain has been navigating these waters for more than 30 years and will narrate the trip as we travel along the Anclote River and out toward the Gulf of Mexico.This evening cruise gives you the chance to look for dolphins, manatees, sea turtles, and coastal birds commonly seen near the Anclote State Preserve. You may spot species like the American Oystercatcher, Bald Eagle, and Piping Plover as we make our way toward the historic Anclote Lighthouse, built in 1887 and still in operation today. Bring your camera - the combination of wildlife, calm Gulf waters, and a Florida sunset
